title: Core Mixins
summary: This module provides foundational mixin classes for model generation and fusion, enabling advanced functionalities like continuous batching, various generation strategies, and optimized model operations.

nodes.label: GenerationMixin
nodes.title: Generation Mixin
nodes.description: Provides core functionalities for text generation, including greedy decoding, multinomial sampling, beam search, and assisted decoding strategies.

nodes.label: ContinuousMixin
nodes.title: Continuous Batching Mixin
nodes.description: Adds continuous batching capabilities to models, optimizing inference for multiple requests by managing a shared batching manager.

nodes.label: PatchEmbeddingsFusionSpec
nodes.title: Patch Embeddings Fusion Specification
nodes.description: Defines how to fuse compatible Conv3d patch embeddings into flattened Linear projections for model optimization.

nodes.label: DiffusionGemmaGenerationMixin
nodes.title: Diffusion Gemma Generation Mixin
nodes.description: Specialized mixin for Diffusion Gemma models, handling autoregressive canvas generation and inner diffusion loops for text generation.

groups.label: Generation Logic
groups.title: Model Generation Logic
groups.description: Classes and methods responsible for controlling how models generate output sequences, including various decoding strategies and batching optimizations.

groups.label: Model Optimization
groups.title: Model Optimization Utilities
groups.description: Components focused on optimizing model architecture and performance, such as fusing layers for efficiency.
